description: This file contains server-side code for the 'SetExam' page of an online examination system. It handles UI interactions such as course selection, adding questions to database, setting up exams, and navigation between pages. It interacts directly with a SQL database to insert questions and exam details, and dynamically populates course lists based on selected semesters.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'SetExam' ASP.NET page, managing quiz question creation, course selection, and navigation within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently has commented code related to session handling.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminQueue page on button click.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminLeaderboard page when clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester, adding specific courses for each semester or a default message.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields related to question and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database, then updates and displays the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam entry in the database for the selected course.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Dynamically updates the course list based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course by querying the database.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
